items.q: And I just started playing bass with Willy Bryant's band, so he called me to fill in for him while he went to New York.

ctx.x: Yeah, Serious Meyers, yeah. And they had had a radio broadcast in New York. And I just started playing bass with Willy Bryant's band, so he called me to fill in for him while he went to New York.
Oh, Willy Bryant was in Philly?
